_comment: Ordered list of store screenshots. `shot` is the raw capture base name in docs/screenshots/raw/{android,ipad}/. Texts are Slovak because both store listings are Slovak. `fullscreen: true` marks viewer screens, which hide the OS bars themselves and must not be cropped.
